messages:
IncidentBot: paging: latency_p99_surge in cont-batching path (us-west-2). p95 normal, p99 ~3-4x baseline. alert threshold breached for last 3m. impacted routes: /v1/generate (streaming), /v1/chat. possible correlated increase in paging evictions. auto-mitigation: none triggered.
Jon: ack oncall here, looking now. any customer reports?
Maya: seeing increased error annotations from streaming clients, some stalls. no 5xx spike yet, just long tails and stream stall detections.
Jon: logs show spike in batch sizes for cont-batcher on host gpu-uw2-14: many mixed-seqlen requests being packed together, KV cache churn high. grabbing tail logs.
Leo: fyi teams using dedicated capacity in uw2 (Docsly + EduCloud) might see degraded streaming latencies. will message SRE for those tenants.
Sophie: dumping scheduler stats:
```
# cont-batcher stats snapshot
avg_batch_size: 18 -> 31 over 5m
seq_len_p50: 64
seq_len_p95: 1024
preempt_evictions: +120/min
kv_cache_misses: +45%
stream_stall_count: 78
```
Jon: that avg batch jump looks suspicious — mixed long sequences pulling short ones into same large batches. scheduler fairness probably skewed.
Arjun: rolling temporary mitigation option: restrict batch max_size to 16 for cont-batcher in uw2 or enable mixed-seqlen isolation. which is lower-risk?
Jon: plan: 1) reduce cont-batcher max_batch_size to 16 for us-west-2 (config change, safe hotpatch). 2) apply shed_policy for streaming routes to preferentially preempt largest batches. 3) spin up isolation pool with lower max_seq_len for streaming traffic as a fallback.
Maya: I'll take 1 and 2. can you draft the config and I'll apply?
Jon: config snippet to apply (staging-ux will mirror):
```
# hotpatch cont-batcher config
cont_batcher:
  max_batch_size: 16
  seqlen_isolation:
    enabled: true
    threshold: 512
  preempt_policy: mixedlen-fair
```
Jon: applying now to uw2-contpool-1...
DeployBot: deploy started: cont-batcher-config-update @jon (run id: dpl-8492)
Jon: applied to pool-1, rolling to pool-2...
DeployBot: deploy succeeded: pool-1 updated (dpl-8492).
Jon: results after pool-1 change: p99 reduced ~30% on pool-1 hosts, streaming stalls down 40%. still elevated in pool-2. continuing roll.
Maya: kicking off isolation pool spinup (contpool-isolate-uw2). template uses max_batch_size 8 and seqlen cap 512.
Leo: notifying customer SREs: "we're applying live mitigations to reduce tail latency; brief degradation possible during rollouts."
Sophie: monitoring dashboards show KV evictions dropping after preempt_policy flip. tail latency trending down; p99 for /v1/chat from 1200ms -> 650ms on updated hosts.
Arjun: if rollouts don't fully mitigate, next step is to enable streaming fallback routing to smaller VMs (dedicated-stream pool) — prep runbook?
Jon: yes — runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/contbatch-mixedlen-fallback (short notes pinned).
Maya: handover note for next on-call (Maya -> Jon 1h later): current status: mitigations applied across uw2; partial rollback not needed. customer impact: intermittent streaming stalls (Docsly, EduCloud) reduced but still elevated for a small percentage of sessions. actions taken: reduced max_batch_size to 16, enabled seqlen_isolation threshold 512, launched contpool-isolate-uw2. monitoring: p95 stable, p99 trending down. followups: postmortem, scheduler fairness tuning, and longer-term: smarter packing by seqlen bucketing.
Jon: tagging followups: SRE to contact top impacted customers, Product if we need to surface SLA notices, ML infra to prioritize KV cache eviction improvements.
Maya: handing off to Jon for overnight watch — I'll be offline after 17:30 UTC. please escalate to Eng-Prod if regression.
Jon: taking handoff — will keep an eye and escalate if >10% of sessions still stall for 10m.
IncidentBot: incident severity updated: P2 -> Monitoring (no data-plane errors, degraded latency).
DeployBot: deploy completed: cont-batcher-config-update rolled to all target pools (dpl-8492).
Sophie: quick note: captured a few sample traces for later root cause analysis and attach to ticket INC-2024-1198. traces: https://internal.redwood/traces/1706201234-1706201500
Leo: closing loop with customers: pinged Docsly SRE (acked, they saw improvements), left note for EduCloud to validate.
Arjun: future mitigation idea: add per-tenant seqlen-aware routing to avoid long-tail tenants pulling others into large batches. filing ticket infra-ops#3245.
Maya: thanks team. I'll write up short incident summary and schedule postmortem tomorrow.
Jon: noted. leaving a short handoff message in the incident channel and closing this thread. :thumbsup:
